_about: Public-domain Isaac Williams (1802-1865, Tractarian poet and divine, Fellow of Trinity College, Oxford) for the Word Hoard: 14 books from Internet Archive scans, 1850-1892, chiefly his Devotional Commentary on the Gospel Narrative (the Harmony, the Nativity, Holy Week, the Passion, the Resurrection and the Ministry), his Apocalypse (1852) and his sermons. His verse, published as 'by the author of The Cathedral', waits in alternates. Raw OCR. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 23 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.

williams-harmony-four-evangelists: A Harmony of the Four Evangelists (London: Francis & John Rivington, 1850)
williams-plain-sermons-catechism: Plain Sermons, on the Latter Part of the Catechism (London: Francis & John Rivington, 1851)
